event_text: xAI Corporation has launched the models Grok 2 and Grok 2 mini , which demonstrate performance on par with leading SOTA models in the market.
Kyutai releases two opensource versions of its voicetovoice model, Moshi .

aa_names: Nova Pro; Nova Lite; Nova Micro
event_text: Amazon introduced a new series of models called NOVA , designed for text, image, and video processing.

aa_names: Grok 3; Grok 3 Reasoning Beta; Grok 3 mini Reasoning (high)
event_text: xAI launches Grok 3 , Grok 3 Reasoning and Grok 3 mini , next-generation AI models trained with 10 times the computing power of Grok 2, significantly improving SOTA performance. They include "Think" and "Big Brain" modes for advanced reasoning, as well as DeepSearch for autonomous web searches.
ElevenLabs rolls out Eleven v3 (alpha) TTS with fine grained emotion control and support for 70+ languages.
xAI releases Grok 4 , achieving a new SOTA of 15.9% on ARC-AGI v2 and 25.4% on Humanity’s Last Exam.
xAI released Grok 4.1 , combining high EQ with strong logic to top the LM Arena leaderboard.

aa_names: Nova 2.0 Omni (medium); Nova 2.0 Pro Preview (medium); Nova 2.0 Sonic
event_text: Amazon unveils the Nova 2 series, highlighted by Nova 2 Sonic , a native speech-to-speech model delivering ultra-low latency and natural conversation flow.
xAI launches the Grok Voice Agent API , enabling native, real-time bidirectional audio streaming for developers.
MiniMax releases MiniMax-M2.1 , a 200k-context MoE model that rises to the top of web development and coding leaderboards, establishing itself as a leading open model for developers.
xAI launches Imagine Video , a video generation model in Grok that quickly rises to the top of public leaderboards.
xAI releases Grok 4.20 , an updated flagship model with improved reasoning and chat performance.
